title: Biometrics Authentification Feature
body:
GM again

- All changes relate to adding an authentification feature ([Issue#430](https://github.com/cashubtc/cashu.me/issues/430)) that can be enabled within the apps setting. 
- The devices native authentification method is used through https://www.npmjs.com/package/@aparajita/capacitor-biometric-auth.
- Authentification is always called after restart. From background authentification can be set (default enabled).
- Tested with Android. Video is attached.

**Commit 1: Add biometric authentication dependencies**
- **package.json**
- Sets up the required Capacitor plugins for the feature.
- Added `@aparajita/capacitor-biometric-auth@^9.1.2` for biometric authentication
- Added `@capacitor/app@^6.0.3` for app lifecycle management

---
**Commit 2: Create authentication state management store**
- Implement Pinia store for biometric and device credential authentication with support for app lifecycle management
- Shows how the store integrates with Quasar's boot system.
- **auth.ts** (NEW - ~240 lines)
  - Created `useAuthStore` Pinia store
  - Implemented state properties:
    - `authEnabled` - persisted to localStorage
    - `requireAuthOnResume` - persisted to localStorage
    - `isAuthenticated` - runtime state
    - `isAuthenticating` - loading state
    - `showAuthPrompt` - dialog visibility
    - `availableBiometrics` - detected biometric types
    - `biometricStrength` - weak or strong biometrics
    - `deviceIsSecure` - device has screen lock
  - Implemented getters:
    - `needsAuthentication` - computed authentication requirement
    - `hasStrongBiometrics` - strong biometric availability
    - `hasBiometrics` - any biometric availability
    - `biometricTypeLabel` - human-readable auth method name
  - Implemented actions:
    - `checkBiometricAvailability()` - detect device capabilities
    - `authenticate()` - trigger native authentication
    - `promptAuthentication()` - authenticate with availability check
    - `enableAuth()` - enable feature with verification
    - `disableAuth()` - disable feature
    - `logout()` - invalidate authentication
    - `startAppStateListener()` - listen for background/foreground
    - `stopAppStateListener()` - cleanup listener
    - `initialize()` - bootstrap authentication system
---

**Commit 3: Add authentication boot initialization**
- Create Quasar boot file to initialize authentication before app renders and add router guard for authentication checks
- **auth.js** (NEW - ~15 lines)
  - Created Quasar boot file for pre-app initialization
  - Called `authStore.initialize()` before app renders
  - Added router `beforeEach` navigation guard
  - Guard shows auth prompt when `needsAuthentication` is true
- **quasar.config.js**
  - Added `"auth"` to boot files array: `["base", "auth", "global-components", "cashu", "i18n"]`
  - Ensures auth initializes after base but before app components

---

**Commit 4: Create authentication prompt dialog component**
- Add full-screen dialog with auto-trigger biometric/PIN authentication and user-friendly error handling
- **AuthPrompt.vue** (NEW - ~220 lines)
  - Created full-screen maximized dialog with fade transitions
  - Implemented `@show` event handler for auto-trigger authentication
  - Added props:
    - `title` - dialog title (default: "Authentication Required")
    - `description` - dialog description
    - `canDisable` - show disable button option
  - Features:
    - Dynamic icon based on biometric type (fingerprint/face/lock)
    - Biometric type chip display (Fingerprint/Face ID/Device PIN)
    - Authenticate button with loading state
    - Optional cancel/disable button
    - Error banner for authentication failures
  - Auto-trigger logic:
    - `onDialogShow()` triggers authentication with 300ms delay
    - Ensures dialog is fully rendered before native prompt
---
**Commit 5: Integrate authentication prompt in main app**
- Add AuthPrompt component to App.vue following Quasar boot pattern for minimal changes to root component
- **App.vue**
  - Added `AuthPrompt` component import
  - Registered `AuthPrompt` in components
  - Added `<AuthPrompt />` to template
  - Kept template minimal (just AuthPrompt + router-view)
  - No initialization logic in component (handled by boot file)

---
**Commit 6: Add security settings UI**
- Add Security section to settings with authentication enable/disable toggle and lock-on-resume option
- **SettingsView.vue** (+65 lines)
  - Added "SECURITY" section divider (between Hardware Features and Privacy)
  - Added security section title and description
  - Implemented authentication enable toggle:
    - Calls `toggleAuth()` method on change
    - Shows current state from `authEnabled` store property
  - Displayed available authentication methods:
    - Shows biometric type chip (fingerprint/Face ID) if available
    - Shows device PIN/password chip if no biometrics
  - Added "Lock when app backgrounds" toggle:
    - Only visible when authentication is enabled
    - Binds to `requireAuthOnResume` store property
  - Imported `useAuthStore` and added to component data
  - Created `toggleAuth()` method:
    - If enabling: calls `authStore.enableAuth()` (prompts for auth)
    - If disabling: calls `authStore.disableAuth()`
  - Added `...mapWritableState(useAuthStore, ["authEnabled", "requireAuthOnResume"])`

---
**Commit 7: Add authentication translations**
- Add English translation strings for security settings section (other translations later?)
- **index.ts**
  - Added `Settings.sections.security: "SECURITY"`
  - Added `Settings.security.title: "Security"`
  - Added `Settings.security.description: "Protect your wallet with biometric authentication or device PIN."`
  - Added `Settings.security.enable_auth.toggle: "Enable authentication"`
  - Added `Settings.security.enable_auth.description: "Require biometric authentication (fingerprint, face ID) or device PIN when opening the wallet."`
  - Added `Settings.security.require_on_resume.toggle: "Lock when app backgrounds"`
  - Added `Settings.security.require_on_resume.description: "Require authentication when returning to the app from background."`

---

Note: I had to upgrade the gradle and JAVA versions in **android/build.gradle**, **android/gradle.properties** and **android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties** to get the project running on my machine (not related to the authentification feature).
